label: early copy steps (outputs 2-3) of short sequences (L=3, partly L=4)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never during the original tokens or on the <DEL> step, and only on short sequences. For L=3 it fires on almost every step that outputs the 2nd or 3rd original token (precision 0.99 on dev), and these steps carry the strongest activations (70% of mass, near-max values). For L=4 it fires more weakly and less reliably, mostly on the step that outputs the 3rd token (about 35% of those steps) and less on the step outputing the 2nd (about 11%). Within L=4, which steps fire depends somewhat on token identity (inputs r/d/p/f/b are over-represented), but no clean token rule shows up. It does not fire on the first copy output (recall 0) or on L>=5 sequences, apart from a small weak tail at L=9 around t=12. Dev: P 0.52, R 0.79, mass recall 0.93. The L=4 false positives are the main precision gap.
